item.text:
Refactored another pass through the codebase.

The main change was tightening the field API from `Object` to `Actor`. [Field.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R011_module_java/Field.java:24) now stores `Actor[][]`, exposes `getActorAt(...)`, and accepts `Actor` in `place(...)`. That let me remove a set of avoidable casts in [Animal.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R011_module_java/Animal.java:177), [FieldStats.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R011_module_java/FieldStats.java:120), and [SimulatorView.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R011_module_java/SimulatorView.java:145).

I also split the view rendering path into smaller helpers in [SimulatorView.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R011_module_java/SimulatorView.java:117). `showStatus(...)` now delegates disease counting, disease text formatting, per-cell drawing, and empty-cell background selection instead of mixing all of that in one large nested block.

Verification: `javac -Xlint:all *.java` passes cleanly. I did not run the Swing UI.
